tools.name: generate_email
tools.title: Generate business email
tools.description: Draft a ready-to-send business email from raw context, calibrated to a tone, audience and length.

context.description: What the email needs to say, plus any relevant background.

tone.description: Desired tone, e.g. formal, friendly, direct, apologetic.

audience.description: Who receives it, e.g. executive team, client, direct report.

length.description: Desired length, e.g. short, medium, detailed.

tools.name: summarize_meeting_notes
tools.title: Summarize meeting notes
tools.description: Turn raw meeting notes or a transcript into a summary, key points, owned action items and deadlines.

notes.description: Raw meeting notes or transcript text.

tools.name: plan_tasks
tools.title: Prioritize and schedule tasks
tools.description: Turn a messy list of work into P0-P2 prioritized tasks with estimates and time blocks inside a working window.

tasks.description: The raw list of work items, one per line.

tools.name: research_briefing
tools.title: Research briefing
tools.description: Produce a professional markdown briefing on a topic: executive summary, key insights, risks and next steps.

depth.description: How deep to go, e.g. quick overview, standard, deep dive.
